sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The gameplay in Tiny Zombies 2 is simple yet addictive. The objective of the game is to defend your area from waves of zombies by killing them before they infect you. The game is divided into levels, with each level featuring a set number of zombies that you must kill before they overwhelm you. As you progress through the game, the zombies will get faster and faster, requiring you to have quick reflexes to survive.

The game controls are simple and intuitive, making it easy for kids to pick up and play. You can use your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to play, and the game responds well to all input methods. Whether you're playing on a desktop computer, laptop, or tablet, Tiny Zombies 2 is easy to control and fun to play.

One of the key mechanics of the game is the 'boost' system. As you kill zombies, you'll earn boost points that you can use to upgrade your defenses and increase your chances of survival. The boost system adds a nice layer of strategy to the game, as you'll need to carefully manage your boost points to stay ahead of the zombies.

Overall, the gameplay in Tiny Zombies 2 is fun and addictive, making it perfect for kids who love a good challenge. With its simple controls and increasing difficulty, the game is sure to keep players engaged for hours on end.
